report:
Status: all three core needs are recorded and confirmed. A — freedom to use the trailer for weekend trips without per-use negotiation. C — ability to use the trailer for their home project within the next few weeks without waiting on A. B — not be put in the middle, clarity on storage, relief at having the trailer off their pad (B rents; landlord approval unknown, B agreed to ask).

Option 2 (keep trailer on B's pad with a written schedule) was rejected by C because it risks them waiting on A again. Option 1 (move trailer to off-pad storage plus a shared booking calendar, with C's project window prioritized in the first few weeks) is favored by B ("option 1 sounds better; I'll ask my landlord") and C (workable if the near-term access is clear), but A has unresolved concerns: a booking calendar is still coordination, and A needs details on storage cost and access logistics before agreeing.

Unresolved: A's concerns about coordination and cost/access details of off-pad storage; B's landlord's answer. Next step would be to gather storage options with concrete cost/access info and re-present to A, then validate a final plan with all three. I made no decisions or commitments on anyone's behalf.
